title: ST-101 Login with valid credentials redirects to home

expected: User lands on the home page within 3 seconds

title: ST-101 Login with wrong password shows generic error
steps: Enter a registered email and a wrong password
expected: Error 'Invalid email or password' is shown

title: ST-102 Reset link is emailed for a valid account
steps: Click 'Forgot password' on the login page
Submit the form and check the inbox

title: ST-104 Search returns matching products
expected: Only products matching 'shoes' are listed within 2 seconds

title: ST-104 Search with no match shows suggestions
expected: 'No products found' and three suggested categories are displayed

title: ST-106 Update display name successfully
steps: Change the name field and click Save
expected: Success toast is shown and the new name persists after reload

expected: Login is rejected with 'Invalid email or password'

Open the cart and type -3 in the quantity field
